conflicts.permit: We share certain data with social media networks and search engine platforms to allow us to target existing Users and prospective customers with highly relevant advertising campaigns.
conflicts.prohibit: Lark does not disclose Personal Data to third parties for their direct marketing purposes.
conflicts.situation: Sharing user personal data with third-party social media or advertising platforms for targeted marketing campaigns.
conflicts.reason: One clause explicitly states Lark does not disclose Personal Data to third parties for direct marketing, while another acknowledges sharing user data with social platforms for targeted advertising campaigns without reconciling the two.
